prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet adoption: Reorder the onboarding sequence so users select and customize their pet before signing in. The sign-in prompt is presented right before pet generation. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate and sign-in drops 27.1% of users before they build emotional investment with a pet.)
1: [home, redesign] Interactive tip carousel on waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen layout to a stage layout with a full interactive tip carousel explaining desktop controls, shortcuts, and hiding mechanisms while waiting. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), and support received multiple complaints about not knowing how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.)
2: [home, wait_info] Progress indicator and desktop alert toggle on waiting screen: Enable visual progress percentage, estimated timer, and system desktop notification switch on the waiting screen. (why: Users wait a median of 201s and mean of 2336s on the home/waiting step with low feedback on progress.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop display shortcut hint on final intro screen: Display a prominent hint on the intro screen detailing shortcut keys (e.g., Ctrl+Shift+P) to bring the pet to the top window. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets do not show on the desktop or users cannot tell if the app opened.)
4: [home, notification] Background notification permission switch on waiting screen: Add a desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen allowing users to minimize the app without missing completion. (why: The average waiting step takes over 30 minutes (2336s mean), causing users to abandon or close the app thinking it crashed.)

scores.note: Delaying sign-in until after value delivery improves conversion, but flow reordering requires structural app changes.
